g.text: CL68 agents and their subagents: the architecture
left in prompts/ as they are,
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: Core, the packs, the framework's identities and the engine's tests lose their prompts/ wrapper; the demos stay as they are; the engine reads everything through one catalogue.
